data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French name Amyrle, meaning 'work of God'. The name Myrlene is a beautiful and unique choice for a Christian girl, carrying a spiritual and biblical meaning. The name Myrlene carries the meaning “Amyrle's light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Myrlene usually hope their child will grow to embody amyrle's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's light and grace.
